ai_semiconductor_news.headline: MediaTek launches Dimensity 9600 Pro on TSMC 2nm
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: MediaTek introduced a 2nm TSMC-based flagship mobile chip with a claimed 51% generative-AI NPU uplift, reinforcing advanced-node and on-device AI demand. MediaTek also says an AI accelerator for a major U.S. cloud provider is targeted for mass production later in 2026.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Intel-veteran startup Delos Data raises $100 million for AI data-center networking
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: The funding highlights interconnect/networking as a bottleneck and beneficiary of increasingly heterogeneous AI compute using Nvidia and rival accelerators, including AMD.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI-safety coordination grows while Washington resists a broad development moratorium
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: OpenAI is working with Anthropic and Google DeepMind on safety; FTC and House leaders warned against exemptions or moratoriums that could slow U.S. competition with China. This reduces the probability that Monday's slowdown rhetoric immediately becomes a broad capex freeze.

narration_points: 9/15美股四大指數再跌：S&P 7585.73 -0.45%、Nasdaq 25981.57 -0.78%、Dow 52093.11 -0.63%、Russell 2870.29 -0.76%；VIX反而小降至16.93，顯示不是全面恐慌，而是利率與能源的估值壓力。
WTI正式結算105.83美元、單日+4.38%；10年債殖利率盤中5.041%、收4.995%，油價→通膨→利率仍是第一主線。
DXY 99.60；12月黃金Reuters報4332.80美元、約-0.4%，但 exact CME settlement 未獨立驗證，因此 canonical close 保持null。
MediaTek發布TSMC 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro，NPU生成式AI效能宣稱提升51%，顯示先進製程與端側AI需求仍在。
Delos Data募資1億美元攻AI資料中心網路，顯示下一個瓶頸從GPU延伸到互連；AI安全合作增加，但華府對全面暫停AI發展態度保留。
最新9/16 session夜盤已在05:00結束，但TAIFEX final在截點尚未獨立取得，OHLC/量保持null；night OI因官方不發布而永久null。
今晚先看08:30 ET零售銷售與進出口物價，再看14:00 FOMC與SEP、14:30 Warsh記者會；市場高度押注25bp升息。
120秒結論：AI需求沒有出現明確CapEx崩塌，但WTI 105.83與10Y接近5%正在壓縮估值。FOMC是否暗示連續升息，將決定半導體反彈能否延續。
